section.title: Document content
section.p: This guide explains how to use tags and tag dictionaries to semantically model, organize, and manage devices, points, and other objects in a system, making it easier for systems integrators to search, navigate, and automate large or complex installations. It covers the process of adding, editing, and removing tags (including direct, implied, and ad hoc tags), creating and managing tag groups and custom tag dictionaries, importing and exporting dictionaries in JSON format, and leveraging smart tag dictionaries like Haystack and Brick for advanced semantic modeling and hierarchy management.
